name: Hilton Honors Credit Cards

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: $0 introductory annual fee for the first year, then $150.

apr.notes: Variable APR based on creditworthiness and the Prime Rate. Cash advance APR 28.74%. Penalty APR 29.99%. Accurate as of 07/24/26.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees from American Express.

credit_required.notes: Not explicitly stated; Amex generally requires good to excellent credit.

categories.label: U.S. restaurants, including takeout and delivery

rewards.redemption_notes: Points redeemable for reward nights, car rentals, shopping, and exclusive experiences through Hilton Honors.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 130,000 Hilton Honors Bonus Points after spending $3,000 in first 6 months.

benefits.title: Hilton Honors Gold Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Hilton Honors Gold status. 80% Bonus on Base Points per stay, space-available room upgrades, daily food and beverage credit or complimentary continental breakfast. Spend $40,000 in a calendar year to upgrade to Diamond Status.

benefits.title: $200 Hilton Credit
benefits.description: Up to $50 in statement credits each quarter for purchases directly with Hilton properties, up to $200/year.

benefits.title: Free Night Reward after $15K Spend
benefits.description: Earn one Free Night Reward after spending $15,000 on eligible purchases in a calendar year. Redeemable for one standard accommodation. Expires one year from issuance.

benefits.title: National Car Rental Emerald Club Executive Status
benefits.description: Complimentary National Car Rental Emerald Club Executive status with Executive Area Access.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees from American Express.

benefits.title: Car Rental Loss & Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Secondary coverage for damage or theft of rental vehicle. Not available in Australia, Italy, and New Zealand.

benefits.title: Global Assist Hotline
benefits.description: 24/7 emergency assistance when traveling more than 100 miles from home.

benefits.title: Baggage Insurance Plan
benefits.description: Coverage for lost, damaged, or stolen baggage. Up to $1,250 for carry-on and $500 for checked baggage.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Protects covered purchases against accidental damage or theft for up to 90 days. Up to $1,000 per purchase, $50,000 per calendar year.

benefits.title: Extended Warranty
benefits.description: Matches Original Manufacturer's Warranty for up to one additional year on covered purchases.

travel_perks.hotel_status: Hilton Honors Gold Status (complimentary); upgrade to Diamond after $40,000 spend in a calendar year
other: National Car Rental Emerald Club Executive Status
